description: Write a SQL query from a plain-English question, using only the tables and columns in the schema you pass. Returns the query, its assumptions, and warnings for any write or unscoped UPDATE/DELETE statement. Nothing is executed. Runs on Utilix's hosted AI: needs a free Utilix API key (UTILIX_API_KEY) and counts toward that account's monthly AI limit.

dialect.description: Optional dialect, e.g. postgres, mysql, sqlite, sqlserver

question.description: What to query, in plain English

schema.description: Optional schema, e.g. CREATE TABLE statements. Strongly recommended

name: ai_generate_sql
